item.title: Man dies in overnight house fire in Philadelphia
item.description: A man is dead after a house fire overnight Tuesday in Philadelphia. Firefighters were called to a three-story home on the 3700 block of Teesdale Street just after 11 p.m.A man was pulled from the home and pronounced dead at the scene, according to authorities.The cause of the fire is still under investigation.Authorities have not identified the victim.
